*   # Job losses concentrated among young Canadians in September

    [From rbc.com](https://www.rbc.com/en/economics/canadian-analysis/data-flashes/job-losses-concentrated-among-young-canadians-in-september/)

    [![](https://assets.faireconomy.media/nfs/npd/2025/04/15/npd_09_38_46.v2.png)](https://www.rbc.com/en/economics/canadian-analysis/data-flashes/job-losses-concentrated-among-young-canadians-in-september/)

    https://www.rbc.com/en/economics/canadian-analysis/data-flashes/job-losses-concentrated-among-young-canadians-in-september/

    Canada’s labour market lost 68,000 jobs in September, driven by losses in public sectors (education and health care), piling onto the 42,000-job loss in the prior month. These losses reversed most of the job growth seen over the summer and leave the year-to-date employment count at -41,000. The monthly employment counts are notoriously volatile, and there are reasons not to read too much into the softer reading too quickly. In September, 70%, or 48,000, of the decline in employment was among those aged 15 to 24, a group that typically sees seasonal headwinds around this time of year after the school year starts. ...
